items.what: Hamiltonian must support addition with 0 on both sides, including __radd__ (0 + H) and the sum-of-Hamiltonians case which starts from int 0.
Hamiltonian must keep working under augmented assignment with zero (H += 0), implying __iadd__ or in-place semantics consistent with the zero case.
Observable needs a reflected addition path (__radd__) so that `0 + obs` works, since int.__add__ returns NotImplemented; the instruction only shows __add__.
